_comment: Example REST bodies for RunPod. Do NOT post unless you intend to create billed resources. Replace YOUR_DOCKERHUB_USER and TEMPLATE_ID_FROM_STEP_1.

body.name: h3-comfyui-serverless
body.readme: H3 ComfyUI serverless worker (worker-comfyui 5.10.0 / ComfyUI 0.34.0). Models on network volume h3-models.

curl_examples.create_template:
curl -sS -X POST https://rest.runpod.io/v1/templates -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNPOD_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- <<'JSON'
{
  "name": "h3-comfyui-serverless",
  "imageName": "YOUR_DOCKERHUB_USER/h3-runpod:5.10.0",
  "isServerless": true,
  "category": "NVIDIA",
  "containerDiskInGb": 40,
  "volumeMountPath": "/runpod-volume",
  "env": { "REFRESH_WORKER": "false", "COMFY_LOG_LEVEL": "INFO" }
}
JSON
curl_examples.create_endpoint:
curl -sS -X POST https://rest.runpod.io/v1/endpoints -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNPOD_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- <<'JSON'
{
  "name": "h3-serverless",
  "templateId": "TEMPLATE_ID_FROM_STEP_1",
  "gpuTypeIds": ["NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090"],
  "gpuCount": 1,
  "workersMin": 0,
  "workersMax": 2,
  "idleTimeout": 300,
  "scalerType": "QUEUE_DELAY",
  "scalerValue": 4,
  "networkVolumeId": "yxvhr288kf",
  "dataCenterIds": ["EU-RO-1"],
  "minCudaVersion": "12.8"
}
JSON
